scope: CP-2A (alias CP-2B) Downside pathway: CP-0 to CP-1 to CP-2A over the frozen financial pack, then the first consumer CP-2G (not yet leased)
status: DRAFT revision 4 (after review-precise-3 and the LEAD rulings of 2026-10-28); scoped re-review pending; not executed
raw_rule: Literal UTF-8 LF, no terminal LF per page; U+000C joins ordered pages for the source SHA256 (same rule as cases/financial/manifest.json)

sources.reuse: Every page text and locator stays byte-identical; read by reference, never edited
Every page text and locator stays byte-identical; read by reference, never edited

no_new_source: CP-2A reads only the settled CP-1 head; the financial pack already carries every operand, so no synthetic source is added

positive.pack_limitation_financial: Unaudited without auditor; borrower, guarantor and restricted perimeters unavailable.
positive.execution: closed run: CP-0, CP-1 (five stages, readiness = submissions.json cp1_downstream_review), CP-2A

gap.execution: closed run on the same CP-1 head construction; CP-1 has no twelve-month ratio for the quarter, so ratios are Not calculable, never 0

refused.pack: financial source missing: no pages/hash, extraction blocked, limitation 'Quarterly financial statements were not supplied.' (cases/financial/manifest.json negative_case)
refused.execution: CP-0 only; CP-1 begin raises NotAuthorized; CP-2A is never begun

blocked.execution: closed run: CP-0, CP-1 as positive, then CP-2A attempt 0 invalid (rejected) and attempt 1 invalid (blocked)

interest_undisclosed.execution: composer only: the positive CP-1 module's facts with the base cash-interest fact and CP-1's coverage fact set to status missing (limitation 'Cash interest is not disclosed in the supplied statements.'); no store, no run (a promoted head cannot be edited)

refusal_cases: submissions.json refusals (payloads) and expected.json refusals (exact issues); each is one journaled invalid step of CP-2A attempt 0 on the positive CP-1 head

fact_selection_rule.predicate: fact.table_id == 'T4.10' and fact.label == '<column> · <metric>' where <column> is the base period column label and <metric> the T4.10 row's field_1 text; exactly one fact per (column, metric) (probe: 500 T4.10 facts, no duplicate label)
fact_selection_rule.fy25_vs_ltm: FY25 carries period 'FY25: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31' and label 'FY25 (...) · metric'; the LTM fact has period 'LTM Q4 25: ...' - the label and period strings differ, so the selection is unique
fact_selection_rule.sign: CP-1 stores cash_interest as an outflow (negative, 'sign normalised'); CP-2A uses its magnitude as the interest operand
fact_selection_rule.probe: S1 positive promoted CP-1 head (read only copy), 2026-10-28: LTM Q4 25 ebitda 30.0, cash_interest -5.00, fcf 9.00, total_debt 50.00, cash_closing 20.00, net_debt 30.00; Q3 25 ebitda 7.5, cash_interest -1.25, fcf 2.25, total_debt 48.75, cash_closing 18.75, net_debt 30.00; Q1-Q3 ratio facts status missing, limitation 'COMPONENT_MISSING; Four complete contiguous quarters spanning 364-371 days are required'
fact_selection_rule.observed_value_class_and_cell_text: expected.json cases.<case>.cp1_inputs (value_class and cell_text as observed; amounts derived from the frozen pages and asserted against the financial oracle by the builder)
fact_selection_rule.fact_ids: interface-fact:<sha256>; bound at run time, never literal

run_time_bindings.figure_placeholders: {{FIG:name|token}} -> {<CP-1 fact_id>|<token>} by fact_selection_rule; unreplaced it is malformed run text (refusal v11)
run_time_bindings.fact_id_marker: {{FACT_ID:name}} in an expected issue -> the CP-1 fact id bound to FIG name

markers.{{INPUTS_SHA256}}: the content hash of the step's prefilled DownstreamInputs
markers.{{EVID:kpi fcf, LTM Q4 25 basis}}: the evidence_id of the one catalogue record matching evidence_predicate with key 'fcf'
markers.{{ALL narrative gap ids}}: every narrative.gaps[*].gap_id, in catalogue order, as separate list elements

basis_record.record_json.label: LTM Q4 25
basis_record.why_not_label_alone: the label 'LTM Q4 25' matches two basis records: this one (column_key 'LTM:fy-2025', scope 'historical', the column the T4.10 'LTM Q4 25 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31)' facts read) and a trailing_four_quarters basis (column_key 'Q:q4-2025'), which no kpi record uses

gap_predicate.note: every retained source and context warning applies to the stress (relevance 'relevant'); ids are cp1-gap:<sha256>

observed_on_probe_store.kpi_calculation_id_fcf: canonical-kpi:5a3256748dcf5081aaa9c2e81f304336d76feb237a95cdbdb7a326cef21661ad (equals the calculation_id of the T4.10 'LTM Q4 25 (...) · fcf' fact)
observed_on_probe_store.note: ids are content hashes of the probe head; a run binds its own by the predicates, the observed values are evidence that the predicates are unique, not literals

cp1_readiness.validator_result: validate_downstream_review: no issues; _assess_consumers row CP-2A status ready_with_limitations; an empty review is not_ready (review-precise-1 section 5, rerun in revision 2 on the literal with markers bound)
